_comment: Per-nation camera overrides merged last by scripts/build-nations.ts. Seeded by WS3 from the point's ABS locality and general geography (not tuned visually): coastal = bearing toward land (bearing is the direction the camera faces), alpine = zoom 11 / pitch 70, flat interior = zoom 9.5. WS2 proposes tuned values via PR. Keys starting with _ are notes. Limits: zoom 8-13, pitch 0-75 (WS2 clamp).

A43._why: Gibson Desert (Ngaanyatjarra-Giles, WA): flat; zoom out so relief reads

A82._why: APY Lands, SA (nearest nation to Uluru): open sand plain

T10._why: South-west Tasmania near the south coast: rugged; face north, inland

L3._why: Gulf St Vincent coast north of Adelaide (Calomba, SA): sea to the west, face east

W3._why: Capes coast (Baudin, WA): Indian Ocean to the west, face east

K1._why: Broome hinterland (Roebuck, WA): coast to the west, flat; face east

E30._why: Point is in the Great Sandy Strait, 1.7 km west of K'gari (Fraser Island): face east onto the island

S66._why: Lake Macquarie west shore (Eraring, NSW): lake and sea to the east, face west to the ranges

Y6._why: Tip of Cape York (Somerset, QLD): sea to the north, face south

N153._why: Point is offshore by the Sir Edward Pellew Group (NT): zoom out to show the islands, face the mainland

G38._why: Mornington Island (Wellesley Islands, QLD): zoom out to show the whole island
